scenario: ReplicationConflictCheck WARNING with an enumerated conflict entry; ReplicationCheck itself is SUCCESS and the bind check is healthy
notes: ReplicationCheck (agreement health) is SUCCESS and the GSSAPI bind check succeeds, so the peer-connectivity-break rule does not fire at all - this fixture specifically demonstrates the 'conflicts do not mean replication is down' distinction. The conflict is enumerated by the ldap_query collector, giving HIGH confidence (a direct LDAP fact) and a DIAGNOSED status at WARNING severity, since conflict entries are a maintenance concern rather than a broken link.
